title: The Alibi of Saint Alder's
author: Juniper Sandoval
blurb: Mara Sterling, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
